recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source edit is needed for FHIR-20826; future changes should be handled as shared participant-pattern work across ActivityDefinition, PlanDefinition, and RequestOrchestration.
issue_request: FHIR-20826 was Published with a Persuasive resolution for R5. It asked to add DeviceDefinition and CapabilityStatement as possible values for Activity/PlanDefinition participant modeling so workflow conformance actors could be represented by definitional or conformance resources; the final resolution was to add DeviceDefinition and CapabilityStatement as potential targets for definitionCanonical.
initial_application: Commit 77ddc7425777f551a6823a98a47c89a0669a87e4 (J#20826) directly applied the change by adding typeCanonical support and CapabilityStatement/DeviceDefinition-related participant targets in ActivityDefinition, PlanDefinition, and RequestOrchestration, and by updating RequestOrchestration.action.participant.actor to actor[x].
additional_context: FHIR-24618 is the same participant-pattern family and supplies the RequestGroup/PlanDefinition definitional participant model that FHIR-20826 extends. Current source has since generalized the canonical target set further to include ActorDefinition, CapabilityStatement, DeviceDefinition, Group, SpecimenDefinition, and StructureDefinition.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current PlanDefinition.actor.option.typeCanonical and PlanDefinition.action.participant.typeCanonical include CapabilityStatement and DeviceDefinition, and the same targets are present in ActivityDefinition.participant.typeCanonical and RequestOrchestration.action.participant.typeCanonical.
